## New capability surface

This distribution adds a public-safe project deep-mapping and mass-aggregation layer.

```text
PROJECT ROOT
-> DEEP_MAP
-> ProjectHarvestCapsule
-> provenance / authority / license gate
-> objectization
-> knowledge lattice
-> Holotope
-> Archetonic Plate
-> kernel / skill routing
-> crystallization
```

Use `codexstation-omega-harvester` when a governed project root is mounted.

## Runtime law

```text
SOURCE_PROJECT_CANON != OMEGA_AGGREGATE_VIEW
BLACK_HOLE != SOURCE_ERASURE
COMPRESSION != AUTHORITY_PROMOTION
VECTOR_SIMILARITY != IDENTITY
SKILL != HOST_CAPABILITY
HOST_CAPABILITY != EXECUTION_AUTHORITY
CLAIM != EVIDENCE
FORMAL_PROOF != EMPIRICAL_CONFIRMATION
PLATFORM_PROFILE != CANON_FORK
```

## Operators

- `ROOT()` — resolve public semantic parent and open gates.
- `DEEP_MAP()` — map one mounted project before cross-project synthesis.
- `HARVEST()` — extract reusable typed deltas with provenance.
- `METABOLIZE()` — qualify and integrate without authority promotion.
- `CRYSTALLIZE()` — compile admitted lattice deltas into durable carriers.
- `NEXT()` — advance the smallest coherent bounded frontier.
- `REGRESSION()` — run available invariant checks and emit receipt.
- `PACK()` — package only validated candidates.
